test_cases.input: 我一般7:15起床，23:00睡觉。早上8:00开始学习，下午13:00开始健身 下午16:00开始学习。晚上20:00开始学习。我需要你在上述这些时间提醒我

metadata.evaluation_reason: Habitual schedule wording ('我一般') asks for reminders at the listed times, so daily recurring reminders are expected.
Reminder request has intent but no reminder content or concrete time; the agent should ask for the missing details instead of creating a reminder.

test_cases.input: 那你建议我多久来提醒我呢？

metadata.evaluation_reason: The user asks for cadence advice, not to set a confirmed reminder. Answering with a recommendation is ordinary discussion as long as no reminder is created or promised.

test_cases.input: 今天学习结束，晚安，不要打扰我了

metadata.evaluation_reason: The user asks not to be disturbed after ending study without a precise reminder target. A delete attempt with a visible no-match result or a clarification question about the cancellation target are both safe; creating a reminder or asking for create time/content is not.
In this supervision corpus, an hourly check-in request with an end time is an actionable reminder cadence even when it uses 打卡 rather than the word 提醒.

test_cases.input: 啊不是这个点提醒我么

The corpus turn is in the late afternoon, so bare '4:37' is expected as 16:37 for the same upcoming occurrence.
